$comment: awesome-kit depends on plugins-kit:skills-kit for the plugin-ecosystem audit framework and skills_kit_lib. bootstrap_lib is REQUIRED: dispatch.py needs bootstrap_lib.codex for launcher resolution and the cmd-metacharacter refusal, and the orchestrate renderer parses routing rows with bootstrap_lib.model_declaration. llm_scripting_kit has no install edge: the renderer DEGRADES without it (rows list only the Claude core ids, disclosed in the render) and dispatch.py REFUSES without it (--model is resolved through its registry); both probe for llm-scripting-kit >= 0.46.0 (describe, discover_model_entries) and diagnose absent and too-old apart. Auto-install skills-kit when missing. requires_bootstrap is set from the newest bootstrap call this plugin makes: orchestration_guidance.py calls bootstrap_lib.model_declaration.parse and CORE_IDS, first shipped in bootstrap 0.129.0 (the plugin-ecosystem skill's BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON launch needs 0.120.0, and dispatch.py's bootstrap_lib.codex.build_codex_exec_argv 0.79.0).
